Hymn 160: Softly Now the Light of Day
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: Carl Maria von Weber
Lyricist/Text Author: George W. Doane
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 160 titled "Softly Now the Light of Day" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Carl Maria von Weber and the lyrics were written by George W. Doane.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
